noah: Postmortem follow-up: need owners + ETAs for customer comms (status page copy, 72h redacted summary, RCA-sharing policy). Also note recurring prefix-cache pressure pattern across recent incidents  want that surfaced. Proposed: @maya status page, @liam 72h summary, @anna + legal_team RCA policy. Ack and ETAs?

maya: Ack. Ill take status page. Draft below, short and clear.

maya: ```
We experienced increased latency and intermittent errors for a subset of requests. Service restored at 11:30 UTC.
Impact: partial degradation for affected requests from 09:4711:30 UTC.
Cause: prefix KV cache pressure (under investigation).
We are tracking this as a recurring pattern and will publish a 72-hour redacted summary with remediation steps.
```

liam: Ack. Ill draft the 72h redacted brief. Question for legal: include stack snippets or keep traces out?

legal_team: Do not include raw traces, session tokens, or internal hostnames in public documents. Enterprise customers may request full artifacts via contract channels.

anna: Comms + product note: we should call out the recurring cache-pressure trend and list concrete next milestones so customers see progress. I can help with the milestones section in the 72h.

noah: Good. Proposed ETAs: status page final by tomorrow EOD (maya), 72h redacted by Fri 17:00 UTC (liam), RCA policy language + CSM guidance by Fri COB (anna/legal_team). Confirm?

maya: Status page PR by tomorrow 18:00 UTC. Ill add a one-line recurring-pattern callout.

liam: 72h ETA OK. Ill flag redacted sections for legal review.

anna: Legal and comms will prepare policy text and CSM script by Friday COB.

opsbot: Created INC-4891 "Comms: status page, 72h summary, RCA policy" assigned to maya/liam/anna, due 2026-04-20. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4891

noah: TL;DR: status page by tomorrow EOD, 72h redacted summary by Fri 17:00 UTC, redacted RCA to impacted customers; full RCA available to enterprise via contract. Remediation owners to be added to tracker separately. If blockers, prefix with "blocker:" so we can escalate. :thumbsup:
